hotspots.title: Trump bans major media outlets from White House access
hotspots.blurb: President Trump announced an immediate ban barring CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House press access, citing dissatisfaction with their coverage and labeling their reporting as fake news. Media ethics groups and press freedom organizations swiftly condemned the decision, arguing it severely undermines constitutional protections and democratic transparency.
hotspots.affect: Banning major national news outlets from press access ignites an intense constitutional battle over press freedom and executive control.

hotspots.title: Trump's proposed DC Arch and Kennedy Center demolition threat
hotspots.blurb: Plans to construct a 250-foot triumphal arch near DCA runways combined with threats to demolish portions of the Kennedy Center have prompted federal court intervention and warnings from aviation experts. A judge ordered a mandatory 30-day notice prior to any structural alterations, while preservationists raise alarms over historical impacts.
hotspots.affect: Threats to demolish national cultural landmarks and erect a massive triumphal arch trigger acute outrage over presidential hubris and historic preservation.

hotspots.title: Trump weighs renewed Iran strikes amid growing public opposition
hotspots.blurb: President Trump is considering renewed military strikes against Iran ahead of key meetings with Gulf leaders, despite fresh polling indicating record-high voter opposition to military conflict. Public dissatisfaction centers on concerns over escalating Middle East tensions and a perceived lack of a clear strategic endgame.
hotspots.affect: The threat of imminent foreign military intervention combined with historic levels of voter opposition creates intense alarm over dangerous geopolitical overreach.

hotspots.title: Trump administration advances major arms sales amidst regional tensions
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration formally cleared a $24.3 billion foreign military sale of 48 F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia. The move comes as Houthi forces escalate regional strikes and foreign allies navigate heightening Middle Eastern conflicts.
hotspots.affect: Advancing multi-billion-dollar advanced arms deals into volatile conflict zones generates sharp contention around foreign policy agendas and defense profiteering.

hotspots.title: State lawsuits and court rulings challenge Trump administration policies
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges and state officials continue to issue rulings halting key administration enforcement efforts, including permanent blocks on SNAP benefit penalties and legal challenges against public charge immigration rules. Civil rights and privacy organizations are actively pressing federal courts to intervene on state citizenship and welfare directives.
hotspots.affect: A steady stream of federal court injunctions against executive actions reinforces a dominant narrative of legal turbulence and constitutional pushback.
